北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗，体感 5℃。风大干燥，注意保暖补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny, but feels like 5℃. It's windy and dry, so stay warm and hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪小雨，气温 10℃。出门带伞，注意防潮保暖呀！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has light rain and is 10℃. Take an umbrella and stay warm and dry!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨，体感 7℃。湿冷添衣，别忘了带伞哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has light rain, feels like 7℃. Dress warmly for the damp cold, and don't forget your umbrella!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，气温 26℃。天气舒适，出门注意防晒呀。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and 26℃. Comfortable weather, but remember sun protection!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗，气温 24℃。阳光正好，出行别忘防晒哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and 24℃. Perfect sunshine, remember sun protection when going out!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州中雨，体感 5℃。雨大湿冷，务必带伞多穿衣！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has moderate rain, feels like 5℃. It's wet and cold, so bring an umbrella and dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京小雨，体感 5℃。湿度高，湿冷加重，保暖防潮是关键！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has light rain, feels like 5℃. High humidity makes it feel colder, so stay warm and dry!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 15℃。早晚温差大，记得添衣哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and 15℃. Big temperature difference between morning and evening, remember to add layers!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，气温 13℃。出行慢行，注意交通安全！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy and 13℃. Drive slowly and be careful on the road!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 8℃。天气干燥，记得多喝水润润喉！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 8℃. It's very dry, so remember to drink more water!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，气温 15℃。温和舒适，出行愉快哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and 15℃. Mild and comfortable, have a pleasant outing!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨扬沙，体感 -8℃。风沙大，务必戴口罩，注意保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin has a sandstorm, feels like -8℃. It's windy and sandy, so wear a mask and stay warm!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 -1℃。天气寒冷，记得多添衣保暖哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels like -1℃. It's cold, so remember to add more layers and stay warm!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 11℃。风力较大，出门注意防风保暖。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 11℃. It's quite windy, so remember to protect yourself from the wind and stay warm.
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，气温 23℃。阳光明媚，出行心情棒棒哒！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and 23℃. Bright sunshine, have a wonderful day out!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感 0℃。风力大，体感寒冷，注意防风保暖哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like 0℃. It's windy and feels cold, so protect yourself from the wind and stay warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -4℃。寒风凛冽，务必多穿衣，别着凉！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -4℃. The wind is biting, so be sure to dress warmly and don't catch a cold!
